about: Motion for the 3D Khepri emblem (docs/brand/README.md, ADR 0005). Values are offsets from rest. Units: the emblem is 1 tall; angles in degrees; rotateX is pitch, rotateY is yaw, applied yaw then pitch. Copies: src/lib/emblem3d/emblem-motion.json and north-ios khepri/Resources/emblem-motion.json; edit this file, then copy (scripts/brand/emblem-guard.sh).
